questions.question: On this day in 1936, Mrs Wallis Simpson obtained a divorce decree, setting in motion a crisis that led to the abdication of which monarch?
questions.explanation: Mrs Simpson's divorce enabled her proposed marriage to King Edward VIII, precipitating a constitutional crisis and his resignation from the throne.
questions.context:
On this day in 1936: Abdication Crisis:  Mrs. Wallis Simpson obtains her divorce, which would eventually allow her to marry King Edward VIII of the United Kingdom, thus forcing his abdication from the throne.
Abdication of Edward VIII (1936 constitutional crisis in Britain): In early December 1936, a constitutional crisis in the British Empire arose when King Edward VIII proposed to marry Wallis Simpson, an American socialite who was divorced from her first husband and was in the process of divorcing her second.

questions.question: Which 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film was written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar as a follow-up to his 2023 hit?
questions.explanation: Jailer 2 is the 2026 sequel to the 2023 action movie Jailer, helmed by Nelson Dilipkumar.
questions.context: Jailer 2 (2026 Indian film by Nelson Dilipkumar): Jailer 2 is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. It was produced by Kalanithi Maran through Sun Pictures. A sequel to Jailer (2023), the film stars Rajinikanth, Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa and Rithvik reprising their roles from the predecessor, with S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Vidya Balan joining the cast.

questions.question: Former English midfielder Michael Carrick served as head coach for which Premier League football team?
questions.explanation: Following a 12-year playing career at Old Trafford, Michael Carrick became head coach of Manchester United.
questions.context: Michael Carrick (English footballer and manager (born 1981)): Michael Carrick is an English professional football coach and former player who is the head coach of Premier League club Manchester United. He is best known for his 12-year playing career with Manchester United, which he also captained in his final season there. Carrick was a midfielder who primarily played in a deep-lying role, but he was also used as an emergency centre-back under Alex Ferguson, David Moyes, Louis van Gaal and José Mourinho.

questions.question: American landscape photographer Ansel Adams co-founded Group f/64, an association promoting which aesthetic approach to photography?
questions.explanation: Group f/64 championed pure photography, which favoured crisp focus and utilizing a photograph's complete tonal scale.
questions.context: Ansel Adams (American photographer and environmentalist (1902–1984)): Ansel Easton Adams was an American landscape photographer and environmentalist known for his black-and-white images of the American West. He helped found Group f/64, an association of photographers advocating "pure" photography which favored sharp focus and the use of the full tonal range of a photograph.

questions.question: The Nazi-era chalet known as the Eagle's Nest (Kehlsteinhaus) stands above Obersalzberg near which town in southeastern Germany?
questions.explanation: Constructed atop the Kehlstein mountain, the Kehlsteinhaus is situated near Berchtesgaden.
questions.context: Kehlsteinhaus (Nazi-era chalet in Obersalzberg, Germany): The Kehlsteinhaus, commonly known in English as the Eagle's Nest, is a Nazi-era chalet situated atop the Kehlstein, a subpeak of the Hoher Göll above Obersalzberg, near Berchtesgaden in southeastern Germany. Completed in 1938, it was commissioned by Martin Bormann on behalf of the Nazi Party for Adolf Hitler, and was intended to host diplomatic functions. Despite its enormous construction cost, Hitler made only 14 brief visits to the Kehlsteinhaus, preferring his nearby Berghof residence.
